text: Yahweh Is Gracious and Compassionateא AlephPraise Yah!I will give thanks to Yahweh with all my heart,ב BethIn the council of the upright and in the congregation.
ג GimelGreat are the works of Yahweh;ד DalethThey are sought by all who delight in them.
ה HeSplendid and majestic is His work,ו VavAnd His righteousness stands forever.
ז ZayinHe has made His wondrous deeds to be remembered;ח HethYahweh is gracious and compassionate.
ט TethHe has given food to those who fear Him;י YodhHe will remember His covenant forever.
כ KaphHe has declared to His people the power of His works,ל LamedhIn giving them an inheritance of the nations.
מ MemThe works of His hands are truth and justice;נ NunAll His precepts are faithful.
ס SamekhThey are upheld forever and ever;ע AyinThey are done in truth and uprightness.
פ PeHe has sent redemption to His people;צ TsadheHe has commanded His covenant forever;ק QophHoly and fearsome is His name.
ר ReshThe fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom;שׂ SinGood insight belongs to all those who do His commandments;ת TavHis praise stands forever.
